changelog: Freefy merged into the gateway; YouTube Music full catalog is now the primary source.
Real radio recommendations via YouTube's /next engine (no more random related tracks).
Artist pages: top tracks, albums, singles, videos, fans-might-also-like.
Album browse with complete ordered tracklists; playlist loading with queue fallback.
Lyrics via YouTube native plus LRCLIB fallback (synced timestamps when available).
16 genre/mood chart sections and advanced search filters (type, date, duration, features, sort).
Health-checked Invidious/Piped mirror failover pools with latency-based routing.
TTL caching for search (5 min), metadata (1 h), and stream URLs (3 min).
